headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Heavy Fighting Spreads
war_summary: Since the last edition, the busiest sectors have grown busier. Weathered Expanse has risen from 38 to 53 strategic-base events in the daily ledger, including 11 in the latest two hours; its line remains divided five Colonial, four Warden bases, with casualties and enlistments still substantial. Stlican Shelf now records 54 events, up from 46, and remains split five Colonial, three Warden, and one neutral. Stonecradle has reached 27 daily events, its nine bases divided five Warden to four Colonial, while Linn’s Mercy has advanced to 14 events and stands six Warden to five Colonial. Callahan’s Passage has climbed from five to eight events, with three recorded in the latest two-hour watch and nine Warden bases against one Colonial. Godcrofts has 22 events, though none in the latest two hours after a violent earlier spell, and its bases remain eight Colonial to one Warden. Deadlands, once active in the previous watch, has fallen to 15 daily events with no movement for several hours. Fisherman’s Row and Marban Hollow also remain active, but their recent tempo is below the principal pressure points.
